contracts: New saves require source and exemplar maps with exactly the selected scene IDs and equal lowercase SHA-256 values. Missing source map may use a complete verified exemplar map.
Each supplied exemplar hash and exact observation passage is checked against current scene prose under the existing shared project lock before any atomic profile replacement.

Reader provenance requires complete valid selected source metadata; a nonempty stored exemplar map must agree. Malformed source metadata remains unknown and excluded from AI, including frozen references.
Schema-1 reads remain unverified without rewriting. Existing same-exemplar profiles with both empty maps can be resaved without promoting their provenance.
Valid older schema-2 source-only profiles may retain absent or empty exemplar maps on read and when switching reference mode; new saves cannot introduce incomplete maps.
Valid frozen references preserve old source versions even after current prose changes; current reference mode excludes changed source versions.
integration_fixture: Approved mobile Writing Voice fixture now supplies the actual selected scene body SHA-256; projection/privacy/digest assertions are unchanged.
